thesis: The episode introduces blockchain technology as a distributed, decentralized database that solves the problem of trusting digital assets without a central authority. It argues that while digital files can be easily copied, blockchain allows individuals to own and prove ownership of digital assets by maintaining a global, append-only ledger that everyone agrees represents the true state of the world.
